label: early original-phase steps after c / 1 / j (diffuse)
explanation: Diffuse unit (5% of steps). Never fires at t=0 and almost never at the <DEL> step. About 69% of activation mass falls in the original phase, peaking at t=2 (13% rate). The rate is highest when the previous or first token is c, 1 or j (prev_tok c 4.1x, 1 3.7x, j 3.3x), and also when the current input is u/g/v/j/i/b. The strongest activations are a high-lift input (v, j, p, b) right after an early c or 1 (e.g. c 1 [v], c c [b]). The remaining ~31% of mass is spread over the copy phase, with small rises at recall_idx 1 and 7-8. The best simple predicate (early original step with c/1/j already seen) gets dev F1 ~0.36 and mass recall ~0.43. Adding more tokens or widening the step window trades precision for recall without getting past F1 ~0.36, so the unit looks like a dense function of token identity and recent history that no compact rule captures.
